notes.title: Update 0.16 Released!
notes.content:
This update aims at bringing to Northern Lights some of the upgraded backend systems that we've been working on for the past months for our next project, as well as to upgrade the game to a newer engine version in hope of solving some game and graphics stability issues!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ELzCRiA.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Input System rewritten from ground up[/b]
--- We have developed a new Input System to be used across our projects. While not much has changed on the surface yet, this will allow us to further expand on game mechanics and how the control scheme works in the future. Some of the future features we plan on adding include: support for rebinding on controllers, use of "hold" and "tap" input actions where fitting, improved controls settings, full controller support (including menus) and more! Stay tuned!
[*] [b]Localization System rewritten from ground up[/b]
--- We have also developed a new Localization System to be used across our projects. The key improvements of the system are improvements of performance when switching languages, as well as better text formatting support, which we will make use of as we continue developing the game further!
[*] Upgraded the game to a newer game engine version (previously Unity 2019, now Unity 2022)
[*] Improved DX12 stability
[*] Added option to enable a dark background on subtitles, making them easier to read with snow on screen.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uBe6gka.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Gulag[/spoiler] Location not initializing correctly (no loot, interactions not working)
[/list]

Once again, thank you for supporting us in our endeavors! We're excited to share more updates with you soon. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 0.15 Released!
notes.content:
This update aims at improving some of the basic items mechanics of Northern Lights as well as fixing some core issues. 

As we continue to develop Northern Lights, our goal is to address all the mechanical and design issues within our resources. From small interaction logic to big systems, our current plan is to revamp all of the Northern Lights specific mechanics, then start diving into re-writting the bigger, more complex systems, which will be shared between our projects. More info to come soon!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ELzCRiA.png[/img]

[*] [b]Torch mechanics rewritten from ground up[/b]
--- Torch now requires inputting a starter to light up, torches can be lit at camp fires, lit torches can light up camp fires. Torch now has sounds. (More improvements to torches and lighting that didn't made it in this update to come in a patch soon)
[*] [b]Glowing stick mechanics rewritten from ground up[/b]
--- Glowing sticks can now be collected in inventory, pressing "Use" on a glowing stick will turn the glowstick on. Lit glowing sticks now show up in the tools panel of the inventory. Lit glowing sticks can be dropped in the world to light the surroundings. (More improvements to torches and lighting that didn't made it in this update to come in a patch soon)

notes.title: Exciting News for Northern Lights Fans & Update 0.14
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sejoLaA.png[/img]

Today, we come to you with both a reflection on the journey we've shared so far and a glimpse into the future of Northern Lights.

As many of you know, Northern Lights has been a labor of love for our small indie team of only three people. Back in 2020, we released our biggest project to date, only to face challenges that stemmed from our lack of experience. The launch didn't meet our expectations, and we struggled with optimization, content, and originality.

Without second thoughts, we embarked on a journey to reshape Northern Lights, releasing significant updates in May 2021 and the game-changing Overhaul update in January 2022. Your support and enthusiasm fueled our passion, and we are immensely grateful for the community that stuck with us through thick and thin.

However, as time passed, interest in our game decreased, and sales went down, forcing each of us to seek additional employment to sustain ourselves and our families. Despite our best efforts, Northern Lights, while now in a better shape than before, has still not recovered.

Today, we find ourselves at a crossroads, contemplating the future of Northern Lights. After careful consideration, including thoughts about quitting development altogether, we've made a decision: we will be continuing development on Northern Lights. But that's not all – we are also excited to share that we are working on a brand new game that incorporates all the lessons, improvements, and gameplay systems we've developed during the Northern Lights journey.

We understand the concerns that may arise, and we want to assure you that every enhancement we make in our new game will also find its way back into Northern Lights. This is not an abandonment; rather, it's a new chapter that allows us to explore fresh ideas while ensuring Northern Lights receives the attention it deserves.

We've faced challenges and learned valuable lessons along this journey, and we believe that our experience will shine through in both projects. We recognize the complexity of this decision, and your understanding means the world to us. We are eager to provide more information about our upcoming game soon, in a later post.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7rKZBQi.png[/img]

notes.title: Winter Sale & Optimization Update 0.12
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zsYCwDf.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings everybody! Today we are proud to announce that Northern Lights is part of the Steam Winter Sale Event at a 50% off discount! And to celebrate this, the Christmas in-game decorations are making a return![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090800/Northern_Lights/

Along with this event, we are also releasing update 0.12 which focuses on improving stability and performance of the game. This is the first stage of our optimization effort, and a first base on which we will continue to add improvements with the coming updates. 

[h3]Better asset streaming[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aogoWli.png[/img]
Northern Lights uses asset streaming in order to load and unload regions of the game without a loading screen. That means that the game loads and unloads assets from disk as it goes. This sounds great in theory, but some of you were having lots of trouble with scenery not loading, missing terrains, falling through map, lag spikes and so on. This was an issue of a middleware tool that we use and is no longer supported, so we decided that in order to get rid of these issues for good, we had to take the step to replace it altogether. And because of this, in the past month we worked hard at developing our own system for streaming scenery. It is not perfect and definitely not final, still a lot of things to solve about it in terms of performance improvements, but a good start in our journey towards a fully smooth experience. 

[h3]Better memory utilization[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/O45CnUv.png[/img]
We've taken a deeper look into what takes so much system memory in Northern Lights, and we manage to shave off up to 2GB of memory used in certain cases. There are still things that we want to address regarding this, but unfortunately we didn’t manage to do it for this update. There will probably be another patch with further improvements regarding memory usage in the near future. 

[h3]Better frame rate in certain locations[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XYEh9jB.png[/img]
We have optimized some of the assets we use in the residential locations. This is still an ongoing process, but for this update expect better performance in most residential locations. As with the previously discussed point, there will be another patch addressing the issue in more locations in the near future. 

[h3]Improved terrain settings [/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/88xdn41.png[/img]
Some of you might have noticed that the terrain quality setting of the game does not do much. This was a big issue that was on our radar for a while, but something we've never got around until now. Setting terrain quality to low should now have a great benefit impact on frame rate, at the cost of texture and effect quality. With this fix in place, we have noticed up to a 30% performance gain on low-end hardware. If your machine is around the minimum specs in terms of graphics performance, expect a good performance boost from this update. 

[h3]And more! Changelog below[/h3]
[list]
[*] New asset streaming system
[*] Improved memory utilization
[*] Improved performance in locations
[*] Improved terrain quality settings
[*] Doors now save their open/close state when saving game
[*] Fixed an issue causing in-location loot to sometimes respawn when loading certain saves
[*] Fixed an issue causing pelt-beds from certain locations to disappear when loading any save
[*] Minor tweaks to some texture resolutions
[/list]

[h3]What is next?[/h3]
[b]In the coming months, along with the aforementioned performance patches, we aim to add new mechanics elements and improve the existing ones. This will include hunting, animal AI remade from the ground up, improving and fixing the issues with story mode, as well as new side quests, and more. We will come with a full roadmap for 2023 in the weeks to come! 

And as always, thanks to everyone for taking time to read this blog post, for supporting us through feedback and purchasing the game, and for being part of our small, yet growing community!

[h2]MadGoat Studio wishes you Happy Holidays and a Merry Christmas![/h2][/b]

notes.title: Update 0.7 is now RELEASED & 35% OFF Sale
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings Arctic Survivors! Today we are proud to announce that Update 0.7 of Northern Lights is now LIVE on STEAM! [/b][/h3]

This version aims to address and improve a lot of the issues and feedback reported by the community over the past months. The overall feel of the game and user experience was also polished in this update!

To celebrate this update, we are also running a limited-time sale for the game! So, if you didn’t already do it, now it’s a great time to pick it up at a lower price!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090800/Northern_Lights/

[h1]What is new?[/h1]
[h2]Loot Spawning Revisited[/h2]
We've received a lot of feedback regarding the loot system. Items used to spawn in the wrong places (bow in the fridge), and the looting interface was clunky. We decided it's worth taking our time and revisiting the loot spawning system. After this update, every item should have its specific place - and furniture, crates, and containers can now be opened to look for items inside!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/drOGf9z.png[/img]

With this change, we've also added the ability to open the trunks and doors of cars, to find and collect loot.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/67R39Ks.jpeg[/img]

We consider this to be the biggest change of this update and something we will still work on polishing in future updates to perfectly balance the resources you can find in the world of Northern Lights!

[b][u]P.S. We know some of you were using loot containers as a way to store your items in your base, and we are looking into ways to make that possible again for the next update. We also advise taking out any loot from containers before updating to avoid losing any progress. Sorry for any inconvenience caused![/u][/b]

[h2]Cooking on Fires[/h2]
Starting with this version, the cooking interface is now unified with the fire interface, which means no more switching between interactions when working with fires!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JVw2Xxa.jpeg[/img]

We have also gone through redesigning the perks of different kinds of fires, and now crafting better fires will result in better cooking times and more slots to put raw food on! Building recipes for fires have also been balanced to make more sense.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/w7FTGnG.png[/img]

Another important feature we’ve added with this update is the ability to harvest burnt fires! Depending on the type of fire, harvesting a burnt fire will now yield some of the materials back as well as a certain amount of charcoal.

[h2]Shelters and Sleeping[/h2]
The shelter mechanism has also got a touch-up with this update! We have improved the way crafted shelters look, as well as the requirements to craft them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NzVjpuk.png[/img]

Shelters now have a decay mechanic, and when they break, it is possible to harvest their remains and take some of the materials back.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7lajznW.png[/img]

We also added perks to the different kinds of shelters, some of them offering cold protection while others have better durability! 
Take note that the kind of bed or shelter you are using now also affects how well you rest!

[h2]Traps and Baiting[/h2]
Baiting in traps now works on a per animal basis. That means that different kind of bait is required for different kind of animals! Bear in mind that some animals can be herbivorous, some omnivorous, while others will only be attracted by meat! The same applies to fish.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PK0LbQk.png[/img]

Carcass ravaging has also been added. Leaving carcasses into traps for too long or using bait that attracts big game will result in the trap being destroyed!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Xfoopc.png[/img]

Destroyed traps can also be harvested to recover some of the initial materials.

[h2]Clothing and Pelts[/h2]
The stats for the various clothing sets available in-game have been balanced to make more sense.

Along with this, we have also added the ability to craft boots from boar pelt. The resource requirement for some of the other pelt-based crafted clothing has been tweaked, and the recipes will now unlock as new pelt kinds are discovered rather than by leveling up.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5NCIvGv.png[/img]

Starting gear has also been tweaked, and the appearance of some clothing items has been improved.

P.s. We are also working on a clothing repair mechanic as promised, but unfortunately it is not ready for this update and will be released with the next version!

[h2]Water Carrying[/h2]
The water bidon mechanic has been improved, and the bidon now has a decay system such that the player is no longer allowed to use a single bidon throughout the whole playthrough.

The bidon will now decay every time water is gathered, and the condition of the bidon is now visible in the inventory.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fyEvKRN.png[/img]

We will continue to improve this mechanic, and we will consider adding more containers and the ability to carry other liquids in the future.

[h2]Parli Italiano?[/h2]
As promised and with the help of our Italian translators, we have managed to fully translate Northern Lights to Italian! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rITSBoO.png[/img]

For new players, the Italian language should now be autodetected. For existing users, the setting should be available in the gameplay settings panel.

[h2]And much more![/h2]

notes.title: Northern Lights Overhaul Update is now RELEASED!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jODMvPB.png[/img]

[h3]Today is a big day for us. After one year of work, we are finally launching the Overhaul Update for Northern Lights! [/h3]

Developing this major update has been a challenging experience, to say the least. During this period, within our small team, we’ve been through difficult times for each of us. The harsh times we live in, lack of funds to continue development and the tragedy of losing people we love have made us consider at some point the idea of abandoning this project.

We are glad we didn’t! After months of hard work, we are finally able to release this huge update that totally changes the gameplay in all its forms!

[previewyoutube=ppBEzHSfM1s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is new?[/h2]
For this update, we took all the ideas and feedback that we've got in the past year and re-thought the whole Northern Lights experience based on them! Here are the most important new features of the game!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fb9TmKt.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Focus on surviving[/b] - The story mode of Northern Lights has become Survival Mode! Survive for as long as you can while waiting for rescue! [b]Game endings are currently undergoing major changes and will be released in a future update![/b]
[*] [b]New First Person Character and Animations[/b] - We replaced the character and animations with higher quality ones!
[*] [b]Slot-based inventory system[/b] - With a strong emphasis on item physical size and weights!
[*] [b]Better looting[/b] - The actual items now spawn in the game world and can be picked by hand! 
[*] [b]New journal system[/b] - The journal now plays an important role in the gameplay. From keeping track of your knowledge and discoveries to crafting, it's all there now!
[*] [b]Updated Health System[/b] - New affliction and treatment system, tweaked health values, and improved overall stability of the system!
[*] [b]Several new locations[/b] - We have also added a bunch of new region-specific locations for everyone to find! 
[*] [b]Updated existing locations[/b] - The previous locations of Northern Lights have been updated with new assets for a fresh new look!
[*] [b]New and Improved items[/b] - New and redesigned tools and handhelds! Every item now has a visual representation in the game!
[*] [b]Improved core mechanics[/b] - We redesigned fire-starting and cooking to be more intuitive and engaging! The other mechanics such as sleeping, fishing, harvesting, etc. have also been "refreshed" to be on par with the rest of the update!
[*] [b]More buildings and crafts[/b] - All the buildings in the game have been remade from the ground up! We have also created new buildings called "Shelters", making it possible to build your own small shelter! Also, the building process is interactive now!
[*] [b]Brand new mechanics[/b] - Researching books for blueprints, water gathering from water bodies, meat salting in salt buckets and more! 
[*] [b]More languages[/b] - With the help of community volunteers on Localizor.com, we translated the game into multiple new languages!
[*] [b]And much more![/b]
[/list] 
[h2]What we fixed?[/h2]
A lot of development time also went into improving and fixing existing features and systems. We wanted to make sure the game is as stable as possible for this release!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CtrdPS9.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Game Core Improvements[/b] - A lot of game core features, such as saving, settings, region loading, etc. were improved. The overall stability of the game was also improved!
[*] [b]Performance Improvements[/b] - The performance and memory usage of the game was improved! 
[*] [b]Graphics Improvements[/b] - The game should look better now!
[*] [b]Lots of bug-fixing[/b] - We managed to fix a lot of issues that have been reported during the previous months by our community!
[/list] 
[h3]In the coming weeks we’ll be sharing more information about our plans for the future of Northern Lights, such as next-gen improvements, more FX sounds, AI overhaul, the return of the endings, and the long-awaited Cooperative Gamemode. [/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q5aNGQO.png[/img]

We hope you’ll enjoy the experience we have created for you, and we want to thank you for your support and patience, as you waited for this day. Thank you for believing in us, as we believe in you!

[h3]All the best,
MadGoat Studio[/h3]

notes.title: Dev Diary 4 - A status update on Northern Lights Overhaul
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings everyone! We want to start this dev diary by apologizing for not posting any more updates here lately. We also want everyone to know that we haven't abandoned the game! [/b][/h3]

We’ve been working hard on addressing all the feedback we’ve received during the initial phase of the early access, and we believe we have finally crafted something that both us and you will be proud of!

Without further ado, here are some of the biggest improvements we've brought to the gameplay!

[h1]Meet the new Backpack System[/h1]

The main concern everybody had with the initial version of the game was the clunky inventory system. With the help of community feedback and ideas, we’ve redesigned the inventory from the ground up!

The new backpack is now limited in both space and weight, making it challenging to manage resources. It is now impossible to carry an infinite number of items, and there are separate pockets for different kinds of items, so think twice before stuffing the backpack with materials!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gqnxLlu.jpeg[/img]

Along with this major change, we have also redesigned the way in which the player interacts with world objects. And such, every interaction is now “drag and drop” based between the backpack and the objects’ item slots. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pOSguJN.png[/img]

This also allows for stacking support so that the players don’t have to input items one by one in world objects as before!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YkNdRav.jpeg[/img]

Another issue we wanted to address was carrying big objects. Instead of going into the inventory, which didn't make much sense previously, big items are now carried by hand, obstructing the player from using handhelds while doing so.

[h1]Journal Improvements[/h1]

We have also worked on improving the journal mechanics, which are now a core feature of the game.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ALz6SAe.jpeg[/img]

The journal now contains everything from health and flora knowledge to craft recipes and building blueprints!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HVkJDIj.png[/img]

Journal entries are now unlocked by exploring the world, experiencing certain aspects of the game, or by leveling up certain skills.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5TCGk5e.jpeg[/img]

[h1]What's left?[/h1]

The update is currently in the testing stage, meaning that most of the new features and improvements are done! This means that we can finally showcase every big change that is coming to the game!

However, we can’t fit everything into one blog post, so we will continue to post regular diaries in the coming few weeks. Stay tuned!

[b]Feedback is important for us, especially now with all the big changes we are making to the game, so don't hesitate to let us know about your potential ideas! Also, let us know how you feel about what we're currently working on! We encourage everyone to get in touch with us over Discord or Steam Community! 

And as always, thanks to everyone for the support![/b]

notes.title: Dev Diary 3 - Rethinking the Health Mechanics (Overhaul Update)
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello community! We are coming with yet another development diary, in which we are going to talk about what we changed related to player health and stats![/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FnuX6hz.png[/img]

By doing more difficulty balance testing and looking through the feedback from the community, we decided the stats system needs an overhaul! As a result, most of the health system changes come from the things we improved with the player stats!

We started by simplifying what affects stats and what stats are affecting, meaning that there will be no more odd behavior between stats during passing time, etc. Some stats also have better names now, to make it easier to understand what their role is in the game (Fatigue is now Energy, Calories is now Hunger, Condition is now Health).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZrnT7fU.jpeg[/img]

We also ditched the clumsy stats menu and the annoying on-screen bars by moving the stats to the player’s wristwatch, which we added back to the game. The wristwatch interface will appear by holding the [T] key.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gsXcTwr.png[/img]

Sanity is now more than a “visual” stat that does nothing! With the overhaul update, we wanted to bring our original sanity mechanic idea to life. So, in addition to the audio-only hallucinations, when going insane, the character will now experience visual hallucinations in the form of wolf packs that will attack you. Failing to defend yourself from hallucinations will result in fainting, which can be dangerous when coupled with low stats.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8UKZath.png[/img]

For all this to make sense and be manageable to the player, we also had to rethink the sanity interface. To achieve this, we moved the sanity indicator to the first person HUD, and we've added sanity notifications that show exactly how much sanity you lose or gain after doing certain actions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/N6aD6hZ.png[/img]

The first thing we wanted to change about afflictions was their complexity. The old affliction system was hard to understand and had a lot of effects that didn't make much sense in the context of our game.

[list]
[*] [b]In the overhaul update, we aim to make afflictions more straightforward and less cluttered.[/b] To do so, we started by removing some of the afflictions which we thought didn't make a lot of sense, as well as removing the "positive" afflictions (Energized, Last Resort, etc.), which are now just health effects that get triggered when the case may be.

[*] [b]We've also added a new affliction named "Fever".[/b] This affliction can be triggered by other diseases and can rapidly kill you if it goes unnoticed. Thus, we decided to add a thermometer icon that will appear on HUD so that the player is aware of it as soon as possible.

[*] [b]Lastly, we have re-designed the way treatments work from the ground up.[/b] No more complicated treatments in the form of loot recipes! Rather than completing complex treatment schemes, treatments now have a progress bar that can be filled by passing time and baring the effects, and/or by consuming natural medication such as herbs, mushrooms, or even resin.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OkNED1H.jpeg[/img]

We are working hard on polishing the game and adding new features for the Overhaul Update. Until the update is ready for release, we aim to publish a weekly dev diary with the new awesome stuff we add to the game to keep everyone updated. So stay tuned for more!

[b]Feedback is important for us, especially now with all the big changes we are making to the game, so don't hesitate to let us know about your potential ideas! Also, let us know how you feel about what we're currently working on! We encourage everyone to get in touch with us over Discord or Steam Community! 

And as always, thanks to everyone for the support![/b]

notes.title: Dev Diary 2 - First steps into Northern Lights Overhaul
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/W4SOMho.jpeg[/img]

Greetings everyone! You’re probably wondering why we’ve been silent for the past few weeks!

And to answer that, the whole team is working hard on the big update, which will completely change the core mechanics of our game and the visual representation of those mechanics.

In this Developer Diary, we will be taking our first steps into showing you some components of the game’s overhaul.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ciCZ982.jpeg[/img]

Big part of the user experience and the part that you will see on screen the most during gameplay sessions is the First Person HUD. So we started by redesigning the HUD from ground up based on feedback from our UX team and the representatives of the community!

The new HUD is more streamlined, less cluttered and takes less vital space on screen. We have also re-themed the whole interface to fit better with our game's "natural" thematic. No more industrial looking UI elements! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/H09RyqD.jpeg[/img]

Another important bit that we noticed from your feedback is that opening a menu to see your current afflictions is annoying and breaks the game flow. To make this a better experience we have moved the list of active afflictions to the HUD and we simplified the data we display for them. This panel can be shown by holding the [Q] key in your keyboard!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8OuodS0.gif[/img]

As a quality of life improvement, looking at an interactable object now also displays contextual information! Looking at a tree trunk? Now you will know if you have the correct tool to harvest it! Found a new coat? You will know if its better or worse than your currently equipped one without having to take it and navigate through menus!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cR0aNLi.gif[/img]

It is also now possible to do certain actions such as harvesting or consuming pickable items without having to loot them first, by accessing their right click menu while inspecting.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/c3mAUhS.jpeg[/img]

We have also put a lot of effort into polishing the world map menu lately! As per your feedback, the map is now displayed in full screen and features a legend to make it easier to understand what you are looking at! The maximum zoom has also been increased.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mEchj4J.jpeg[/img]

A new feature for the mapping system is the addition of the push-pins to the game! Push-pins can be used to mark locations such as loot caches and points of interests on the map. And to make things more interesting, they have to be found and looted while exploring certain locations before they can be used!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TzZIZ41.jpeg[/img]

Note that the number of push-pins the player will be allowed to loot and carry will be limited to balance difficulty and to avoid filling the map with pins!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OkNED1H.jpeg[/img]

We are working hard on polishing the game and on adding new features for the Overhaul Update, and until the update is ready for release, we aim to publish a weekly dev diary with the new awesome stuff we add to the game to keep everyone updated. So stay tuned for more! 

[b]Feedback is important for us, especially now with all the big changes we are making to the game, so don't hesitate to let us know about your potential ideas! Also let us know how you feel about what we're currently working on! We encourage everyone to get in touch with us over Discord or Steam Community!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o6DGhmS.png[/img]

[b]We heard you! Based on the feedback we've received, we redesigned the whole world of our game to be more fun to explore and feel less like a walking simulator while maintaining the core experience of the game![/b] More vegetation, less empty space, better design and more intuitive navigation, the new world has it all!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gg20vb3.png[/img]

[b]The new island also spans a vast road system that connects the big locations. [/b]Got lost? Just find a road and follow it, maybe you will reach civilization!

[b]The addition of location signs across the world also means that there is no more wandering around in nature without finding anything![/b] Road signs can be taken as hints to what you'll find at the end of your journey!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m7RQKnN.png[/img]

[b]The caves scattered around the island also got redesigned from ground up,[/b] with brand new assets, extra detail, and better level design. No more plain corridors with nothing to see around!

On top of that, we also added new ambiance and detail sounds to caves for that extra immersion!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KzPoLSo.png[/img]

[b]The new world also comes with improved loot spawning! [/b]This means that it will be easier to find natural resources in places where they should be.

[b]We have also introduced group spawning, meaning that you can find more resources of a kind in a location that is rich in a given resource.[/b] This is still a work-in-progress feature and we will keep improving it with the next updates based on your feedback!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a4mHYh2.png[/img]

[b]Performance just got better! [/b]We've made sure to fix a big chunk of the freezes & hiccups that were occurring during playthrough (some we are still looking into though), as well as to improve the general performance of the game. 

The scalability of the graphics settings and the performance in relation to hardware was also addressed, meaning that changing the settings will actually make a difference in performance now!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EsBhny3.png[/img]

[b]Along with the big changes, we have also improved and fixed the following:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added camera warm filters in interiors
[*] Added an extra ping in intro quest to facilitate navigation to the objective through blizzard
[*] Added back some missing audio lines to some dialogues
[*] Added some new sounds to water, vegetation and caves
[*] Improvements to animal and loot spawning balance
[*] Improvements to sound design
[*] Improvements to world survey mechanics
[*] Fixed various issues with herb spawning
[*] Fixed various issues with graphics 
[*] Fixed various issues with interactables
[*] Fixed various issues with UI
[*] Fixed various issues with quests and objectives
[*] Fixed an issue causing some particle effects to tank performance
[*] Fixed an issue causing credits to be unskippable upon finishing the story
[/list]
[b]We are also aware of all the issues that have been reported during the past few weeks. Unfortunately due to the sheer amount of work that has been put into making this update possible, we were unable to look into those issues in time for this release. We will investigate and solve them as soon as possible![/b]

[b]Be aware! Old saves will still work, however, we strongly recommend starting a new game if possible as some data from the old map will not be carried over with the save upgrade, and certain aspects of the play-through might break.
And as a side note, it is still possible to access the v0.2 version of the game by accessing  Library/NorthernLights/Properties/Betas and selecting the legacy_v0.2 branch!
[/b]

[b]As always, we want to thank everyone for the support and feedback! And as Northern Lights is still an Early Access title, we encourage everyone to get in touch with us over Discord or Steam Community about potential issues or ideas!
[/b]

notes.title: Northern Lights Update - 0.2.0 NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everybody![/h3]
We are happy to announce that Northern Lights version 0.2.0 is now LIVE on STEAM. 

This is our first major update, which is focusing on improving stability and core functionality of the game, along with various fixes to issues that have been reported by the community. 

We are also aware that the development pace seems a bit slow between the updates but we want to remind everyone that there is a lot of work involved in fixing and improving the game, and we are only three developers working on the game full time!

[h3]Changelog 0.2.0[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added support for changing control bindings. (and preparation for future controller support)
[*] Added support for inverted mouse look settings.
[*] Added support for metric-imperial unit conversion .
[*] Added support for skipping cutscenes in game.

[*] Major improvements to AI performance and spawning count.
[*] Major improvements to ground loot spawning count.
[*] Major improvements to footstep sounds. 
[*] Major improvements to world streaming & unloading performance. 
[*] Major improvements to snow rendering at night.
[*] Major improvements to overal interactibility with world objects.

[*] Mending and shredding are different UI panels now.
[*] Fishing yields smaller fish more often now.
[*] It is possible to take all items in a storage structure at once now.
[*] It is possible to craft the max possible ammount of a blueprint, as a separate craft button.
[*] Map opens focused on the player location rather than centered now.
[*] Map also displays location names under the icons now.
[*] Quests display heads up notifications when starting or updating now.
[*] Stats on HUD now blink red when too low.
[*] Fires now display their burning time left when hovering mouse on them.
[*] [spoiler]Improvements to River Village locked house's mechanics & loot.[/spoiler]
[*] Tweaked carcass harvesting tool decay values.
[*] Tweaked bonfire warmth bonus.

[*] Fixed issue causing nature objects to not disappear when harvested. (branches, trunks etc.)
[*] Fixed issue causing looting to not work correclty if the character is walking while pressing E on smaller objects.
[*] Fixed issue causing corpses to not yield sub-items in container items. (i.e. empty bottles without the content)
[*] Fixed issue causing shivers to have incorrect audio clips in russian.
[*] Fixed issue causing fishing huts to display as bridges on map.
[*] Fixed issue causing heads-up text to get stuck on screen when leaving to menu.
[*] Fixed issue causing heads-up text to not scale correctly with non 16:9 aspect ratios.
[*] Fixed issue causing fire UI to no longer update time while opened.
[*] Fixed various collision issues.
[*] Fixed various localization text.
[/list]

[h3]Future plans and Roadmap[/h3]
Along with the upcoming fixes and minor improvements, from now we will also focus on overhauling the game and user interfaces to make the gameplay more intuitive and to get rid of as much redundant menus and user actions as possible, along with making the game more immersive. 

Our plan for the near future is to improve existing gameplay features, add new gameplay elements, add more locations and landmarks to explore, and to make the interfaces easier to use and more intuitive to the end user. Improving the performance of the game, along with the graphics fidelity, will also remain one of the top priorities.

We will release an updated roadmap with more details shortly.

[h3]Update on the Chinese Localization[/h3]
As some of you might know, we promised to add Chinese Language support with this update. 

Unfortunately, due to the fact that we encountered some issues with our previous Chinese translator, this is not yet possible. 

We are currently looking for a new chinese translator and we will see how we will go about it in the near future. We will post another update as soon as we figure it out!

[h3]Note[/h3]
P.S. We want to remind everyone that Northern Lights is in an Early Access state so there might still be a lot of bugs to be ironed and a lot balancing to be done. 

Because of this, we encourage everyone to use the [b]Report A Bug [/b] button found in the Game Menus in order to reach to us about possible issues! Also don't forget to join our Community and Discord Server where we have chats dedicated for feedback and new ideas!

Thank you for reading and for all your support and understanding!
